deviation: Clause 13.2 bars both parties from terminating for convenience, removing Arcadia's core right to exit on 30 days' notice (and even the 90-day fallback). Arcadia would be locked in for the full term and could exit only for cause. Clause 13.3(a) also makes Arcadia pay for the Supplier's non-cancellable commitments on termination, which is an open-ended cost with no cap or pre-approval.
suggested_text: 13.2 The Customer may terminate this Agreement or any SOW for convenience at any time by giving the Supplier 30 days' written notice, without penalty or early termination fee. 13.3 On termination or expiry, (a) the Customer shall pay all undisputed Fees for Services properly performed up to the effective date of termination, and no other fees, charges or compensation shall be payable by reason of termination for convenience; (b) each party shall return or destroy the other's Confidential Information on request, subject to Section 8.5; and (c) licences granted under Section 6.3 continue only for Deliverables for which the Fees have been paid in full. [Clauses 13.1 and 13.4 unchanged.]
